variants.name: Chicken 14 kg
variants.about_this_item: ADVANTAGES: 30/16 – balanced growth and development formula for daily feeding For puppies aged up to 1 year 100% quality animal protein Optimal granule for puppies of all breeds Mixture of tocopherols as a natural antioxidant Vitamins D3, E, B1, B5, microelements, and amino acids Omega 3 + Omega 6 for healthy skin and shiny coat INTEGRAMIX formula: dried tomatoes, ginger, hawthorn, and bananas – for overall pet health No artificial flavors and colorants
variants.ingredient_information:
Composition: COMPOSITION: dehydrated chicken protein 30 %, maize, rice, poultry fat (preserved with tocopherols), maize gluten, oats, hydrolyzed animal protein, sugar beet pulp, minerals, salmon oil 0,5 %, brewery yeast, linseed 0,4 %, banana* 0,23 %, tomatoes* 0,2 %, hawthorn* 0,065 %, ginger* 0,01 %.

Analytical constituents: ANALYTICAL CONSTITUENTS: crude protein 30 %, сrude fat 16 %, crude ash 6,2 %, crude fibre 2,2 %, calcium 1,3 %, phosphorus 1 %, omega-3 fatty acids 0,38 %, omega-6 fatty acids 3,48 %.

Additives: ADDITIVES (per kg of product): Nutritional additives: vitamin A (3а672а): 15 000 IU, vitamin D3 (3а671): 1 200 IU, vitamin E (3а700): 400 mg, vitamin K3 (3а711): 6,52 mg, vitamin B1 (3а821): 2,99 mg, vitamin B2 (3a825i): 9,1 mg, vitamin B5 (calcium-D-pantothenate 3a841): 23,73 mg, niacin (3a314): 29,6 mg, vitamin B6 (3а831): 3,48 mg, folic acid (3а316): 0,52 mg, vitamin B12 (3a835): 0,209 mg, biotin (3а880): 0,118 mg, choline (choline chloride 3а890): 1,35 g; zinc (3b605): 97,96 mg, copper (3b405): 10,5 mg, selenium (3b801) 0,074 mg; antioxidants, preservatives. *Natural ingredients, dried. Metabolizable energy per 100 g of pet food: 1 615 kJ (386 kcal).
